Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Voluntarily participate in this study and sign an informed consent form.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent, satisfying this criterion.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Participants diagnosed with HCC through pathological histology/cytology or clinically diagnosed with HCC according to the Diagnosis and Treatment Guidelines for Primary Liver Cancer (2024 Edition).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's diagnosis of HCC.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Within 4-12 weeks prior to enrollment, radical resection surgery was performed.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any recent liver surgery.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Complete recovery from surgical resection within 4 weeks prior to enrollment.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on whether the patient has undergone or recovered from any liver surgery.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: High risk factors for postoperative recurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma include multiple tumors, tumor length>5 cm, poor tumor differentiation (Edmondson III-IV grade), margin ≤ 1 cm, invasion of Microvasculature or large vessels, lymph node metastasis, sustained abnormalities in AFP or abnormal prothrombin, etc.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's profile does not provide details on tumor characteristics or risk factors for HCC recurrence.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Child Pugh liver function rating within 7 days prior to randomization: A or B (≤ 7 points).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's liver function rating is not provided in the data.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: ECOG PS score within 7 days before randomization: 0-1 points.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's ECOG performance status is not mentioned.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have not received systematic anti-tumor treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma in the past.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on whether the patient has received any anti-tumor treatment for HCC.
The patient's expected survival time is not specified.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The main organ functions meet the following requirements (within 7 days before randomization): (1) Blood routine examination: (excluding hemoglobin, no blood transfusion within 14 days prior to screening, no use of granulocyte colony-stimulating factor [G-CSF], no medication correction): • Neutrophil absolute count ≥ 1.5 × 109/L; Platelets ≥ 75 × 10^9/L; • Hemoglobin ≥ 90 g/L.(Leukocyte and thrombocytopenia caused by splenic hyperfunction can be included in the group after partial embolization of the splenic artery or medication correction) (2) Blood biochemistry test (no albumin transfusion within 14 days before screening): Serum albumin ≥ 28g/L; Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN; ALT and AST ≤ 3 × ULN; Blood creatinine ≤ 1.5 x ULN or Cr clearance rate>50ml/min (3) International standardized ratio (INR) ≤ 2.3 or prothrombin time (PT) exceeding the range of normal control ≤ 6 (4) Urinary protein<2+(If urinary protein ≥ 2+, 24-hour urine protein quantification is required, and 24-hour urine protein quantification<1.0g can be included in the group).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's organ function test results are not provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: If suffering from hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, it is necessary to be willing to receive antiviral treatment throughout the study period (according to the diagnostic and treatment guidelines, such as entecavir) and regularly monitor it; Hepatitis C virus (HCV) ribonucleic acid (RNA) positive subjects must receive antiviral treatment according to the diagnosis and treatment guidelines, and their liver function must be within CTCAE1 level elevation.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of HBV or HCV infection in the patient's profile.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Women with fertility: must agree to contraception from the signing of the informed consent form until 90 days after the last use of the study drug (whichever is longer). And the blood HCG test must be negative within 7 days before starting the study treatment; And it must be non lactation period.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male, making this criterion irrelevant.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known hepatobiliary carcinoma, sarcoma like hepatocellular carcinoma, combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma，and fibrous layer cell carcinoma; Within 5 years or simultaneously suffering from other active malignant tumors other than hepatocellular carcinoma (excluding cured skin basal cell carcinoma and cervical carcinoma in situ).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of other active malignant tumors is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: There are uncontrollable extrahepatic metastases, such as lung and brain metastases (EHS).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on whether the patient has uncontrollable extrahepatic metastases.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Previously received local treatment, including therapeutic TACE, transarterial embolization (TAE), hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy (HAIC), transarterial radiation embolization (TARE), etc.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of local treatments for liver conditions is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Participants who are preparing to undergo or have previously received organ or allogeneic bone marrow transplantation.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on whether the patient has undergone or is preparing for organ or bone marrow transplantation.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Participants who are currently accompanied by interstitial pneumonia or interstitial lung disease, or have a history of interstitial pneumonia or interstitial lung disease that requires hormone therapy in the past, or other pulmonary fibrosis, organized pneumonia (such as bronchiolitis obliterans), pneumoconiosis, drug-related pneumonia, idiopathic pneumonia, or subjects with evidence of active pneumonia or severe lung function impairment seen on chest computed tomography (CT) images during screening, are allowed to have radiation induced pneumonia in the radiation field; Active tuberculosis.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of lung diseases or active tuberculosis is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Currently, there is active autoimmune disease or a history of autoimmune disease that may recur (including but not limited to: autoimmune hepatitis, interstitial pneumonia, uveitis, enteritis, pituitary inflammation, vasculitis, nephritis, hyperthyroidism, hypothyroidism [subjects that can be controlled only through hormone replacement therapy can be included]); Subjects with skin diseases that do not need systematic treatment, such as vitiligo, psoriasis, alopecia, controlled type I diabetes that receive insulin treatment, or childhood asthma that has completely alleviated without any intervention after adulthood can be included; Asthma subjects who require medical intervention with bronchodilators cannot be included.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of autoimmune diseases or asthma is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Suffering from hypertension and unable to achieve good control through antihypertensive drug treatment (systolic ≥ 140 mmHg or diastolic ≥ 90 mmHg) (based on the average BP reading obtained from ≥ 2 measurements), it is allowed to achieve the above parameters through the use of antihypertensive therapy; Previously experienced hypertensive crisis or hypertensive encephalopathy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's blood pressure control status is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with moderate to severe ascites with clinical symptoms who require therapeutic puncture or drainage, or whose Child Pugh score is greater than 7 (excluding those who only show a small amount of ascites on imaging but do not have clinical symptoms); Uncontrolled or moderate to equal amounts of pleural effusion and pericardial effusion.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's ascites status or pleural/pericardial effusion is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: There are clinical symptoms or diseases of the heart that cannot be well controlled, such as: (1) According to the standards of the New York Heart Association (NYHA), level II or above cardiac insufficiency or cardiac ultrasound examination: LVEF (left ventricular ejection fraction)<50%; (2) Unstable angina pectoris; (3) Have experienced myocardial infarction within one year prior to the start of the research treatment; (4) Clinically significant supraventricular or ventricular arrhythmias require treatment or intervention; (5) QTc>480ms (QTc interval is calculated using the Fridericia formula; if QTc is abnormal, it can be detected continuously three times every 2 minutes, and the average value is taken).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a history of multiple myocardial infarctions and impaired left ventricular function, indicating uncontrolled cardiac disease.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of spontaneous rupture of liver tumors.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on whether the patient has a history of liver tumor rupture.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Individuals with a history of hepatic encephalopathy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of hepatic encephalopathy is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Congenital or acquired immune dysfunction in subjects (such as HIV infected individuals).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's immune status is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: There have been incidents of thrombosis or embolism occurring within the first 6 months of treatment, such as cerebrovascular accidents (including transient ischemic attacks, cerebral hemorrhage, cerebral infarction), pulmonary embolism, etc.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of thrombosis or embolism is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with a history of gastrointestinal bleeding or a clear tendency towards gastrointestinal bleeding within 6 months prior to the start of the study treatment, such as those at risk of bleeding or severe esophageal and gastric varices, locally active gastrointestinal ulcer lesions, or continuous positive fecal occult blood, cannot be included in the study. (If fecal occult blood is positive during the baseline period, a follow-up examination is required. If the follow-up examination is still positive, gastroduodenoscopy (EGD) is required. If EGD indicates a risk of bleeding, esophageal and gastric varices/other gastrointestinal diseases cannot be included in the study.)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of gastrointestinal bleeding is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Within 6 months prior to the start of treatment, there have been abdominal fistulas, gastrointestinal perforation, or abdominal abscesses.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of abdominal fistulas, perforations, or abscesses is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Severe, unhealed or cracked wounds, as well as active ulcers or untreated fractures.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of severe wounds or ulcers is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known genetic or acquired bleeding (such as coagulation dysfunction) or thrombotic tendencies, such as in hemophilia patients; Currently or recently (within 10 days prior to the start of research treatment), full dose oral or injection anticoagulants or thrombolytic drugs (prophylactic use of low-dose aspirin, low molecular weight heparin allowed) have been used for therapeutic purposes.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of bleeding or thrombotic tendencies is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Major vascular diseases (such as aortic aneurysm requiring surgical repair or recent peripheral arterial thrombosis) occur within 6 months prior to the start of the study treatment.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of major vascular diseases is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Severe infection within 4 weeks prior to the start of the study treatment, including but not limited to hospitalization due to complications of infection, bacteremia, or severe pneumonia; Oral or intravenous administration of therapeutic antibiotics within 2 weeks prior to the start of the study treatment (subjects who receive prophylactic antibiotics, such as preventing urinary tract infections or exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, are eligible to participate in the study).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of severe infections is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: It is known that the active ingredients and excipients contained in the investigational drugs (Adebelimumab, Apatinib) in this study have hypersensitivity reactions, or have a history of severe allergies to any other monoclonal antibodies or anti angiogenic targeted drugs.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of drug hypersensitivity is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Use immunosuppressive agents or systemic hormone therapy within 14 days prior to the start of the study to achieve immunosuppressive effects (dose>10mg/day prednisone or other therapeutic hormones).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's use of immunosuppressive agents or systemic hormone therapy is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Received attenuated live vaccine treatment within 28 days prior to the start of the study treatment, or expected to receive such vaccines during the treatment period with Adebrelimab or within 60 days after the last dose of Adebrelimab.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of live vaccine treatment is not mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Received other experimental drug treatments within 28 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) prior to the start of the study treatment.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of experimental drug treatments is not provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: According to the judgment of the researchers, the subjects may have other factors that may affect the research results or cause the study to be terminated midway, such as alcoholism, drug abuse, other serious illnesses (including mental illness) that require concurrent treatment, serious laboratory test abnormalities, and family or social factors that may affect the safety of the subjects.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's history of alcoholism, drug abuse, or other serious illnesses is not mentioned.

Recap: The patient meets the informed consent criterion but lacks sufficient information to assess other inclusion criteria. The patient's cardiac history, including multiple myocardial infarctions and impaired left ventricular function, violates the exclusion criteria related to uncontrolled cardiac disease.
